name: Drive home
description: Night motorway seen through a rain-covered windscreen - headlights, tail lights and sodium street lamps as bokeh, with drops sliding down the glass and dragging the whole image with them. The only effect here with a place in it.

speed.description: Road speed. Small numbers: the traffic scrolls slowly even at the top of the range.

rainRate.description: How fast rain slides down the glass. It is the busiest motion in the frame, so this is the knob that decides whether the shot feels like a drive or a chase.

rain.description: Strength of the drop refraction. At 0 the windscreen is dry and the lights go sharp.

shake.description: Suspension bumps. Driven from the low end, so the car rides the track.

flare.description: Overall brightness of every light source.

tint.description: Blend toward the project palette. Kept low by default - sodium orange and red tail lights are most of what makes the scene read as a road at night.
